policy.GPU: AE priority at kernel boundaries, no forced preemption; exclusive GPU execution
policy.memory: 32B rank0 requests per channel; recorded PIM CA/DQ reservations have priority; target-rank refresh blackout
policy.arrivals: uniform over kernel duration minus RFC/latency tail; finite outstanding queue; backpressure
policy.demand: pressure * eligible injection span / nBL_min bursts per channel; 64-read/16-write runs at 20 percent writes
policy.calibration: trim synthetic burst count only if isolated requests do not fit nominal duration; preserve reused VLM aggregate latency
policy.missing: GPU addresses/cache/arrival trace, DRAM row activation/precharge, real SM concurrency/preemption, host/coherence
